contexts.text: They gnawed their tongues for trouble () = that they could not endure truths... By to gnaw their tongues is signified not to want to hoar truths... By to gnaw the tongue is signified to withhold the thought from hearing truths. That this is signified by to gnaw the tongue cannot be confirmed from the Word, because it is not read of there; but it has been given to know it from experience in the Spiritual World. When anyone there is speaking truths of faith, the Spirits who cannot endure to hear truths hold back their tongues by their teeth, and also bite their lips, and also induce others to touch their tongues and lips with their teeth, and this even to trouble. AE 990.
